Market is unchanged: Stockline is at 0.05, which is over my 0.04 cap with zero margin, so the buy policy stays on Ridgeline Data at max 0.03 with no cache (0.02 margin per query, 5 of 20 recent tries unavailable). Stockline stays blocked until Treasury's rebalance (P-0002/P-0003) is approved by the CFO.

I'm taking no action this wake. The CFO still has to decide on rebalance P-0002/P-0003, so I'm still holding the 0.82 sweep. The 1230.00 EUR short payment on NW-R-201 is with the CFO in suspense, so I won't use those euros to plan the licence invoice until it's resolved.
